# Shambhave Wellness Foundation

> Non-profit arm of Shambhave Wellness running community mental health programmes, subsidised therapy and volunteering in India.

Shambhave Wellness Foundation is a registered non-profit organization dedicated to fostering social, emotional, and psychological well-being for senior citizens, women, and underserved communities.

## Key facts

- Location: Orchid Petals, Sector 49, Gurugram, Haryana 122018, India
- Phone: +919315311334
- Email: info@shambhavewellness.org
- Languages: English, Hindi

## Projects

- [Our Social Impact Projects & Initiatives](https://foundation.shambhavewellness.org/projects): Explore our community-driven mental health projects, senior citizen wellness circles, women empowerment workshops, and youth psychological first-aid programs.
- [Community Outreach for Elderly Women Mental Health](https://foundation.shambhavewellness.org/project/community-outreach-elderly-women-mental-health-suppor): Supporting elderly women through mental health awareness, emotional wellness programs, counseling, and community outreach initiatives.
- [Mental Health Outreach for Senior Women](https://foundation.shambhavewellness.org/project/mental-health-outreach-for-senior-women): Empowering senior women with mental health support, emotional care, awareness programs, and community-based wellness initiatives.
- [Spreading Smiles Healing Hearts | Wellness Initiative](https://foundation.shambhavewellness.org/project/spreading-smiles-healing-hearts): A compassionate initiative promoting emotional healing, mental wellness, happiness, and community support for vulnerable individuals.

## Volunteering

- [Volunteer With Us](https://foundation.shambhavewellness.org/volunteers): Join our passionate volunteer network. Help build compassionate mental health circles, organize wellness workshops, and support underserved communities.
- [AARAVDEEP SINDHU | Volunteer Profile](https://foundation.shambhavewellness.org/volunteer/aaravdeep-sindhu): Learn about AARAVDEEP SINDHU's impactful journey and service with Shambhave Wellness Foundation in promoting mental health and community well-being.
